propositions: Production Python functions in src/rebar over complexity threshold 15 must remain at or below their recorded ceiling; new or increased complexity debt blocks pre-commit and CI

A shrink-only baseline wrapper accepts Ruff return codes 0 and 1 with valid C901 JSON, parses AST-qualified symbols as ceiling keys, and exits nonzero only for new debt, increased debt, or scanner/schema errors
The baseline JSON schema validates schema_version, duplicate keys, unsorted keys, invalid UTF-8, and requires each ceiling value to be an integer greater than 15

The --update-stale maintenance mode rewrites only stale entries (lower ceilings or remove absent diagnostics) through atomic_write, refusing new or increased debt, with byte-idempotent behavior when no changes exist
Symbol identity uses Python AST node ancestry (nested functions with equal leaf names under different parents, async methods) and rejects duplicate same-qualified-key definitions
The repository gate is wired into make lint and computes four mutually exclusive counters: active (matching ceiling), new (unlisted), increased (over ceiling), stale (improved or removed)
